column3: “Grown” renders going on; “lips” and “hearts” stand for mouth and kidneys.
“The wicked” supplies the pronoun’s referent; “set apart” renders consecrating.
“Stumble” stands for trusting in the peaceful land.
“Of you” stands for speaking good things to you.
“Love of My life” recasts beloved of My soul.
The first verb is plural where the Hebrew has a singular subject.
